entities.summary: Martin Gyarko Oti is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Techiman North Constituency in the Bono East Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party. He was the former Deputy Minister for Bono East Region.
